name: Curtis Finley
why: Cropped from a photograph of him and his wife, in a 1992 Talisman feature on married students. The index reads "Finley, Curt 58-60"; the story, Cheryl A. Edwards's "Taking their vows to class", runs pp. 58-60 with photographs by Marc Piscotty, and names him as a London senior married to Kirsten Finley, a junior from Ft. Lauderdale, Florida. The frame used is the one on p. 60 captioned "Kirsten and Curt Finley laugh while watching 'The Golden Girls' on television". Two people are in it, a man behind and a woman in front, and the caption names one of each, so the man is Curt; his wife is named in the same story as the woman. He is turned three-quarters to the camera and his face is unobstructed. The Talisman indexes no other Finley in this period.
caption_quote: Kirsten and Curt Finley laugh while watching "The Golden Girls" on television
